description:
In this episode, we follow the  journey of Adam Robinson, founder of Retention.com, as he pushes his company toward a $50M ARR goal. Adam shares the raw realities of scaling a business, from navigating hiring challenges and market shifts to the mental game of entrepreneurship. He reflects on the nonlinear path to success, the power of perception in leadership, and the crucial role of risk-taking in high-growth companies. Along the way, we see the emotional toll of relentless ambition, the strategic pivots needed to sustain momentum, and the unexpected lessons that shape the future of a fast-growing startup.

🎥 Watch now for an unfiltered look at the highs, lows, and game-changing lessons of building a $50M business!
fulltitle: Scaling a Startup Is Harder Than You Think…
